title: Bond strength.
officialText:
The cohesive/adhesive bond strength of the cured sprayed fire-resistant material applied to floor, roof
and wall assemblies and structural members shall not be less than 150 pounds per square foot (psf) (7.18 kN/m2). The
cohesive/adhesive bond strength shall be determined in accordance with the field test specified in ASTM E 736 by testing in -place
samples of the sprayed fire-resistant material selected in accordance with Sections 1704.11.6.1 through 1704.11.6.3.
